lines.zh: 沙尘遮蔽我的脚步，我来了。
lines.en: Dust obscures my steps, but I’m here.
Movement in the shadows.
My steps are heavy and firm.
Each step shatters the void.
Guardian of the Shadow Wasteland.
The Black Charro comes.
Shadows in the night.
I am the messenger of the night.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中寻找你的影子。
lines.en: Seek your shadow in the dark.
The sign of the Cursed Knight.

lines.zh: 黑曜石碎片在我靴跟下响。
lines.en: Obsidian shards crunch under my heels.
Eternal shadows.
Your end awaits.
I am the incarnation of the night.

lines.zh: 无需害怕，我是你唯一的希望。
lines.en: Fear not, I am your only hope.
Power and fear coexist.
Darkness is my home.
Death’s kiss.
I come to purify this land.
Wait, then destroy.

lines.zh: 黑曜石甲片在夜里发凉。
lines.en: My obsidian plates grow cold at night.
I count the breaths inside this tomb.
The soulbound charm still holds some warmth.
My hooves scrape softly beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 等待下一个献上灵魂的人。
lines.en: I wait for the next soul to be offered.
I stand inside my own legend.

lines.zh: 我的暗影马，已经在嘶鸣。
lines.en: My shadow horse is already neighing.
Now, it's your turn.

lines.zh: 我的暗影马，已经在陵墓外等着。
lines.en: My shadow horse already waits outside the tomb.
Face your fear.

lines.zh: 你身后的影子比夜还长。
lines.en: The shadow behind you is longer than the night.
You should not have come to the ritual site.
Shake, mortal.
Feel despair.

lines.zh: 我的暗影马在陵墓外等你。
lines.en: My shadow steed waits outside the tomb.
You are still clutching that charm.

lines.zh: 你带了缚魂护符，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the soul-bound charm on you.
Do not blink. I can teleport.
Your sword hurt me a lot!
Hmph, that's all you've got?
My shadow horse charges; the reins snap taut.
Damn, hit me again!
You can't hurt me!
This is my territory!
My black horse steps out of the shadow.
I won't lose!

lines.zh: 我不介意再多打一会儿！
lines.en: I don't mind fighting a bit longer!
You can't defeat me!

lines.zh: 它的黑影在沙漠中游荡，仿佛夜的恶灵。
lines.en: Its dark shadow roamed the desert like a night demon.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的怒气，火焰在你心中燃烧。
lines.en: You feel its rage, flames burning in your heart.

lines.zh: 它咀嚼着灵魂，每一口都是痛苦的折磨。
lines.en: It devours souls, each bite a torment.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛如同深渊，注视着每一个生灵。
lines.en: Its eyes are like abysses, staring at every soul.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的嘶吼响彻峡谷，夜空为之颤抖。
lines.en: Black Charro's roar echoes through the canyon, shaking the night sky.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片坚硬如岩石，难以突破。
lines.en: Its scales are as hard as rock, tough to pierce.

lines.zh: 夜晚，它潜伏于暗影荒原，等待猎物。
lines.en: At night, it lurks in the Shadow Wastes, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 它的暗影法球击中你，带来无尽的恐惧。
lines.en: Its Shadow Ball hits you, bringing endless fear.

lines.zh: 它在恶地中漫步，如同死亡的化身。
lines.en: It walks the Wastes, an avatar of death.

lines.zh: 它吞噬灵魂，留下无尽诅咒。
lines.en: It devours souls, leaving endless curses.

lines.zh: 你试图攻击它，但它用暗影将你吞噬。
lines.en: You attack it, but it devours you with shadow.

lines.zh: 你与黑恰罗相撞，却被它的力量震退。
lines.en: You collide with Black Charro, but are repelled by its power.

lines.zh: 它的攻击如雷鸣般震撼，你难以抵挡。
lines.en: Its attacks are like thunder, impossible to resist.

lines.zh: 你被它的力量击中，感受到痛苦的煎熬。
lines.en: You are hit by its power, feeling the pain.

lines.zh: 它的暗影冲撞，将你撕裂成碎片。
lines.en: Its shadow crashes, tearing you into fragments.

lines.zh: 你与黑恰罗碰撞，但它毫发无损。
lines.en: You collide with Black Charro, but it remains unharmed.

lines.zh: 它的力量如此巨大，你只能后退。
lines.en: Its power is so great, you can only retreat.

lines.zh: 你试图接近它，但被它的力量震开。
lines.en: You try to approach it, but are repelled by its power.

lines.zh: 它的攻击无处不在，你躲避不及。
lines.en: Its attacks are everywhere, you can't dodge.

lines.zh: 你被它的力量击退，退到安全之地。
lines.en: You are repelled by its power, retreating to safety.

lines.zh: 它发出深沉的吼声，寻找配偶。
lines.en: It emits a deep roar, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的嘶鸣吸引着同类。
lines.en: Black Charro's snarls attract its kind.

lines.zh: 它的叫声穿透黑夜，回应着同类。
lines.en: Its call echoes through the night, answering its kin.

lines.zh: 它在沙漠中寻找伴侣，声音回荡。
lines.en: It searches for a mate in the desert, its voice echoing.

lines.zh: 同类的叫声让黑恰罗更加激动。
lines.en: The call of its kind makes Black Charro more excited.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声在夜空中回响。
lines.en: Its mating call echoes in the night sky.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的吼声震动大地，呼唤同伴。
lines.en: Black Charro's roar shakes the earth, calling its companions.

lines.zh: 它在暗影荒原中寻找伴侣，声音悠长。
lines.en: It searches for a mate in the Shadow Wastes, its voice long.

lines.zh: 同类的回音使黑恰罗更加渴望。
lines.en: hungry for a mate.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的嘶鸣，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: It emits a low growl, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的触须像黑曜石般闪耀。
lines.en: The Charro's触须闪耀着 obsidian light.

lines.zh: 它饥饿的咆哮回荡在暗影之中。
lines.en: Its hungry growl echoes in the shadows.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的鳞甲覆盖全身。
lines.en: The Charro's scales cover its body.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的眼睛在注视着你。
lines.en: Eyes in the darkness are watching you.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的影子在陵墓中游走。
lines.en: The Charro's shadow wanders the tomb.

lines.zh: 你感受到黑恰罗的气息。
lines.en: You sense the Charro's presence.
It feeds on souls.
The Charro appears at night.
It teleports close to you.

lines.zh: 击败它掉落黑曜石碎片。
lines.en: Defeat it to drop obsidian shards.
Target that shadow!
The Charro is in the tomb.
The Charro appears in the darkness.
Its presence unsettles you.
It's the master of the night.
The Charro is deep in the tomb.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的阴影越来越近。
lines.en: The Charro's shadow grows closer.
The Charro in the shadows.
Its presence threatens you.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的攻击即将来临。
lines.en: The Charro's attack is coming.

lines.zh: 你的名字从陵墓里传来。
lines.en: Your name echoes out of the tomb.
I heard you crush the sand underfoot.

lines.zh: 第三阶段的耐心用完了。
lines.en: My patience for this phase is spent.
My obsidian blade is already raised.
You have woken the night.
The offering could just as well be you.
A shadow orb turns in my palm.
My steed has caught your scent.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的影子在你周围游弋。
lines.en: The Charro's shadow sways around you.
My shadow horse paws the sand.
The Charro is targeting you.
Be careful, its attacks are deadly.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的攻击无处不在。
lines.en: The Charro's attacks are everywhere.
Its attacks penetrate armor.
The Charro's shadow surrounds you.

lines.zh: 它的攻击让你喘不过气。
lines.en: Its attacks make you breathe hard.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的攻击无孔不入。
lines.en: The Charro's attacks find every opening.

lines.zh: 黑恰罗的攻击如影随形。
lines.en: The Charro's attacks follow you.
The overhead cut will come first.
The sweeping combo follows at once.

lines.zh: 暗影马已经踏过你的影子。
lines.en: My shadow steed has already crossed your shadow.
The orb seals your retreat first.
Sand has filled your eyes.
My hooves are getting louder.
Armor will not stop a shadow.

lines.zh: 我的剑尖挑着你的后退。
lines.en: My blade tip follows every step you retreat.
I have practiced this cut for two centuries.
The tomb walls are closing in.
Sword slices like a shadow, silent in the night.
In the shadows, I am justice.
Each strike steals a soul.
Soul sacrifices to the Night Lord.
Dance of death starts beneath your feet.
Dark powers consume the light.
Teleport to death, nowhere to run.
Shadow wall, those who oppose die.
Swallow souls, strengthen myself.
Night's abyss, my home.
The overhead cut falls. Do not look up!
My sweep crosses your waist!
The shadow orb strikes you square!
The blade is faster from the saddle!
I came for the pact, and I collect!
My curse is carved into your bones.
Night falls, and I awake.
Desert depths, the tomb appears.
Badlands above, my domain.
Shadow Wastes, my home.
Soul-binding amulet, summoning ritual.
Soul shards, curse origin.
Dark heart, eternal master.
Night reveals, Charro's might.
Tomb rises, Dark King.
Night's light, my end.
The soulbound charm has burned out.
The tomb door opened by itself.

lines.zh: 沙漠夜里多了一道蹄印。
lines.en: One more hoofprint in the desert night.
The Shadow Wastes welcome their knight.
Over the badlands, I rein in my steed.
The Black Charro rides out of the crypt.
The Cursed Knight record will spin.
I come as summoned, out of obsidian.
Hooves sound under the sand first.
The night has gained a pair of red eyes.
The flames burned me!
The rocks hurt my head!
The water drowned me!

lines.zh: 爆炸震得我五脏六腑疼！
lines.en: The explosion hurt my insides!
The arrow pierced me!
Magic burned my skin!
Starvation weakened me!
Lightning struck me!
Void drained my strength!
